name: edge-unruled-whitespace
title: Edge case: white space 31 places otherwise
description: An edge-case fixture (#1508, Task 35 fix round 1): two differences no ruling covers, shown rather than avoided. The letter's reply writes the marker of follow_up, a macro the model chose, whose body ends with a line ending; the problems deliverable prepends clinic_line, whose read of the unset clinic ends its line. Each problem paragraph has problem_close placed after it by the engine, its body ending in more white space than one line ending. Fictional; not intended for clinical use.
